name: sprint10_taker_imbalance_btc
hypothesis: Trailing 5-minute taker buy/sell volume imbalance predicts BTCUSD/ETHUSD returns over the next 15 minutes in the direction of the imbalance (informed flow persistence).
power_argument: Assuming ~35bps stdev for 15-min crypto returns (typical intraday realized vol, an assumption not a briefing fact), SE at n=300 is ~2.0bps; a t>=2.5 pre-registration bar implies a ~5bps gross detection floor. Round-trip cost at fee_tier T2 (~10bps) sets the success bar at net>15bps, well above the noise floor -- so the design can fail on a true null rather than by construction (exp14 lesson).
